description: This file defines SCSS variables for styling a web project, including fonts, responsive headings, blockquote styles, shadows, transitions, border radiuses, button styles, global media queries, link colors, dividers, masks, cards, images, carousels, badges, footers, forms, input groups, list groups, modals, navigation bars, pagination, tables, and steppers. The variables are used for theming and consistent styling throughout the project.
